summary: Avalanche Treasury Corp filed an 8-K announcing the closing of its business combination with Mountain Lake Acquisition Corp (MLAC), a SPAC. The de-SPAC transaction, initially agreed October 1, 2025 and amended twice, resulted in AVAT's Class A common stock trading on Nasdaq. No per-share price, premium, or advisor details are included; the filing is purely a closing announcement. The press release is furnished, not filed. Structurally, the combination involved two merger subs in a typical SPAC merger. Investors should watch for any post-closing redemptions (overhang) and AVAT's ability to maintain its Nasdaq listing amid crypto market volatility, key risk factors cited in forward-looking statements.
